evidence.estrutura: Her organizing grew from local Black communities and participatory movement institutions, supporting grassroots power rather than centralized elite control.
evidence.representacao: Voting-rights organizing and the Mississippi Freedom Democratic Party make her exceptionally strong on democratic inclusion.
evidence.poder: Her experience of police abuse, racial terror and suppression of Black voters strongly supports civil-libertarian constraints on coercive authority.
evidence.imigracao: Her politics centered racial equality rather than immigration; universal dignity supports pluralism, but a border-policy score should stay moderate.
evidence.diplomacia: Foreign policy was not central to her legacy; keep moderate-to-diplomatic rather than infer militarism.
evidence.intervencao: No detailed foreign-intervention doctrine is established; anti-oppression principles support restraint.
evidence.economia: Freedom Farm and anti-poverty work support redistribution, community economic security and a larger social role than laissez-faire capitalism.
evidence.controle: Community programs and public anti-poverty action support moderate public coordination without command planning.
evidence.religiao: Christian faith was central to her rhetoric and activism, so she is more religious personally than many civil-rights peers, without advocating theocracy.
evidence.moral: Civil rights and human dignity are strongly egalitarian; her religious worldview warrants a progressive-but-not-maximal modern cultural score.
